question: Analyze the past performance of all the asset types, stock, commodity, real estate, forex and propose which type of asset is worth to invest in based on investors' risk apetite
query: SELECT      'Stocks' AS asset_type,     AVG(close_price) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(close_price) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50 UNION ALL SELECT      'Commodities' AS asset_type,     AVG(crude_oil_price) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(crude_oil_price) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50 UNION ALL SELECT      'Commodities' AS asset_type,     AVG(gold_price) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(gold_price) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50 UNION ALL SELECT      'Real Estate' AS asset_type,     AVG(real_estate_index) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(real_estate_index) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50 UNION ALL SELECT      'Forex' AS asset_type,     AVG(forex_usd_eur) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(forex_usd_eur) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50 UNION ALL SELECT      'Forex' AS asset_type,     AVG(forex_usd_jpy) AS avg_price,     STDDEV(forex_usd_jpy) AS std_dev_price FROM finance_economics_dataset LIMIT 50;
